### CVE-2019-5069
- Assigner: talos | Published: 2019-09-05 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-502 CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

A code execution vulnerability exists in Epignosis eFront LMS v5.2.12. A specially crafted web request can cause unsafe deserialization potentially resulting in PHP code being executed. An attacker can send a crafted web parameter to trigger this vulnerability.

Affected:
- n/a / Epignosis: affected Epignosis eFront LMS v5.2.12

References:
- https://talosintelligence.com/vulnerability_reports/TALOS-2019-0858 [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2019-6977
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2019-01-27 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 46677: PHP 7.2 - 'imagecolormatch()' Out of Band Heap Write (remote/php, 2019-02-27, verified=0)

gdImageColorMatch in gd_color_match.c in the GD Graphics Library (aka LibGD) 2.2.5, as used in the imagecolormatch function in PHP before 5.6.40, 7.x before 7.1.26, 7.2.x before 7.2.14, and 7.3.x before 7.3.1, has a heap-based buffer overflow. This can be exploited by an attacker who is able to trigger imagecolormatch calls with crafted image data.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

An issue was discovered in ZZZCMS zzzphp V1.6.1. In the inc/zzz_template.php file, the parserIfLabel() function's filtering is not strict, resulting in PHP code execution, as demonstrated by the if:assert substring.

### CVE-2019-11043 — Underflow in PHP-FPM can lead to RCE
- Assigner: php | Published: 2019-10-28 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 8.7
- CWE: CWE-120 CWE-120 Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2022-03-25, ransomware=Known — PHP FastCGI Process Manager (FPM) Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 48182: PHP-FPM - Underflow Remote Code Execution (Metasploit) (remote/php, 2020-03-09, verified=1)
- Exploit-DB 47553: PHP-FPM + Nginx - Remote Code Execution (webapps/php, 2019-10-28, verified=0)

In PHP versions 7.1.x below 7.1.33, 7.2.x below 7.2.24 and 7.3.x below 7.3.11 in certain configurations of FPM setup it is possible to cause FPM module to write past allocated buffers into the space reserved for FCGI protocol data, thus opening the possibility of remote code execution.

**exploits:** Exploit described at https://github.com/neex/phuip-fpizdam

**workarounds:** Configuring nginx (or other server that implements the front-end part of the FPM protocol) to check for the existence of the target file before passing it to PHP FPM (e.g. "try_files $uri =404" or "if (-f $uri)" in nginx) for would prevent this vulnerability from happening.

Affected:
- PHP / PHP: affected 7.1.x <7.1.33 (custom); affected 7.2.x <7.2.24 (custom); affected 7.3.x <7.3.11 (custom)

Credits: Reported by Emil Lerner.
